results.name: Separate evidence categories and untrusted text
Independent corroboration does not rewrite user provenance
Fork from known checkpoint without future memories
Unknown lineage stays suspended until isolated user selection
Exact duplicates deduplicate within a branch only
Ambiguous repeated outcome without stable source identity
Rename with explicitly supported identity continuity
Same pilot changes lance slot and pawn
New occupant reuses original callsign and slot
Conflicting observations require explicit supported correction
Reject summaries that leak future history or upgrade reports
Deletion and export policy dry run with shared ancestry

limits: All state, identities, sources and observations are stipulated synthetic inputs.
Source/category, reference and branch checks do not prove arbitrary summary prose entailment.
No memory text is interpreted as an operation, command, authority or tool request.
Only eight typed operations and this bounded fixture vocabulary are modeled.
Reports include oracle comparisons; model transitions and projections do not read expected outputs.
No saves, database, network, game/editor, actual export or deletion are accessed.
